name: Mrs. J. L. Truscott
role: Wife of J. L. Truscott (née Maggie Gardient)
bio: Mrs. J. L. Truscott, née Maggie Gardient, arrived in Medora in July 1885 and first stayed at the Northern Pacific. By early 1886 the Truscotts were living at the Spring Creek ranch.

moments.label: Arrived in Medora as Mrs. Truscott

mentions: Mrs. J. L. Truscott, nee Miss Maggie Gardient, arrived Monday evening. She will live at the Northern Pacific until Mr. Truscott finishes his house on the ranch.
Mrs. Molloy returned yesterday from a visit to Mr. and Mrs. Truscott's, at the Spring creek ranch.
…Monday, Dec, 8th., 1886, at 6 p. m., after three days illness, Margaret, only daughter of Mr. and Mrs. J. L. Truscott.
